description: This file defines the PHP class 'Administration' which manages system configuration settings for SuiteCRM, including retrieving, saving, and handling SMTP and email settings. It also enforces access restrictions at entry point and interacts with various system components.

classes.name: Administration
classes.description: A class managing administration and configuration settings within the SuiteCRM application, extending SugarBean for database interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Administration object and sets up custom fields.

methods.name: checkSmtpError
methods.description: Checks for SMTP configuration errors and optionally displays a warning.

methods.name: retrieveSettings
methods.description: Retrieves system settings from the database, with optional category filtering and cache utilization.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves configuration settings from $_POST data, including outbound email settings.

methods.name: saveSetting
methods.description: Saves a specific configuration setting into the database, handles encryption for sensitive data.

methods.name: get_config_prefix
methods.description: Extracts category and key parts from a configuration string.
